caveat: Synthetic stand-in corpus, whose phones are stationary resonances with no formant transitions. A segment's per-channel count vector is therefore very close to a complete description of the phone, which is exactly the condition 7.1 calls 'a spectral profile task wearing a spiking costume'. The index measured here is a property of this corpus and must not be read as P1's answer for T1; that needs TIMIT (O2).
